decisions: Final layout: Mosaic grid variant B (4x3 adaptive) chosen for hero image to balance scannability and context
Diff format: horizontal 3-up strip chosen over stacked vertical because it reads better in blog header and social previews
Annotations: use 2-tier callouts (primary orange label for product change, secondary gray label for technical note)
Fallback assets: provide un-annotated images for customer-facing docs and annotated images for engineering/PR use
notes: Trade-offs: drove for minimal annotation overlap to keep screenshots legible at thumbnail sizes; that resulted in slightly larger mosaic tiles which required two crop rules. Engineering confirmed no PII or telemetry visible—the screenshot export script masks user IDs.
